meta.name: RPSGT Scoring Lab Phase 3 consecutive-epoch pack
meta.sourceBasis: The runs reuse the existing original Sleep Pathways Guild 30-second W/N1/N2/N3/REM teaching epochs so learners can practice neighboring-epoch decisions without copying patient recordings or source figures.
meta.clinicalBoundary: Adjacent-epoch order is pedagogic and does not imply a mandatory sleep-stage progression. Real studies require the current official scoring criteria and full clinical context.

runs.title: Sleep-onset sequence
runs.focus: Compare neighboring epochs as wake-oriented activity gives way to N1 and then N2.

epochs.rationale: Posterior alpha, eye activity, and relatively higher chin tone support the intended wake teaching pattern.
Low-amplitude mixed/theta-oriented EEG with slow eye movements and a vertex teaching feature supports the intended N1 pattern.
A low-amplitude mixed-frequency background with a K-complex and spindle teaching region supports the intended N2 pattern.

runs.title: NREM deepening sequence
runs.focus: Keep the neighboring epochs visible while the teaching sequence progresses from N1 through N2 into N3.

epochs.rationale: The schematic emphasizes N1-oriented low-amplitude mixed/theta activity and slow eye movements without N2-defining teaching features.
The spindle and K-complex teaching features distinguish this schematic N2 epoch from its neighbors.
Large frontal slow-wave teaching activity dominates this schematic epoch, supporting the intended N3 pattern.

runs.title: Lightening NREM sequence
runs.focus: Practice adjacent-epoch decisions when deep NREM gives way to lighter NREM teaching patterns.

epochs.rationale: Sustained high-amplitude frontal slow-wave teaching activity supports the intended N3 pattern.
The schematic returns to a low-amplitude mixed-frequency background with N2 teaching morphology.
The final epoch uses an N1-oriented mixed/theta background with slow eye movements and no N2 teaching marker.

runs.title: REM-to-awakening context
runs.focus: Compare N2, REM, and wake teaching epochs without treating a neighboring stage as a substitute for the current epoch's evidence.

epochs.rationale: The K-complex and spindle teaching regions support the intended N2 pattern before the REM teaching epoch.
Low-amplitude mixed-frequency EEG, rapid eye movements, and low chin tone support the intended REM teaching pattern.
Posterior alpha, eye activity, and higher chin tone support the intended wake teaching pattern after the REM teaching epoch.
